Class AccountContactRelationTriggerHandlerTest

@IsTest()
private class AccountContactRelationTriggerHandlerTest

Test class for AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler. Validates email notification duplicate prevention, main notification contact designation, and BlazeBite agent count tracking across insert, update, and delete trigger contexts.

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    06/26/2021

Version:
    1.5


Change Log

  • 06/26/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version
  • 06/28/2021 - v1.1 - Added testAfterUpdate2() for multiple records on the same account
  • 05/22/2022 - v1.2 - Updated to use trigger framework and TestDataFactory new methods
  • 11/18/2023 - v1.3 - Added testAfterInsertUpdateNumberOfAgentsAssigned() and testAfterDelete()
  • 06/16/2024 - v1.4 - Implemented afterInsert and afterUpdate.handleMultipleMainContacts trigger settings
  • 12/27/2024 - v1.5 - Updated test methods to use IsMainNotificationContact__c field

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
setCommonData()
Creates a test Account with an ExternalId__c and a test Contact with all triggers disabled to establish baseline data.
private static void
testAfterDelete()
Verifies that afterDelete resets NumberOfAgentsAssigned__c to zero on the customer account when all BlazeBite agent relations are deleted.
private static void
testAfterInsertHandleMultipleMainContacts()
Verifies that afterInsert unchecks IsMainNotificationContact__c on the first relation when a second relation is inserted with the same notification type and main contact flag.
private static void
testAfterInsertUpdateNumberOfAgentsAssigned()
Verifies that afterInsert updates NumberOfAgentsAssigned__c on the customer account when BlazeBite agent relations are inserted.
private static void
testAfterUpdate1()
Verifies that afterUpdate transfers the main notification contact flag from the first relation to the second when the second is updated with the same notification type and IsMainNotificationContact__c set to true.
private static void
testAfterUpdate2()
Verifies that afterUpdate keeps only the last relation as the main notification contact when multiple relations on the same account are updated simultaneously with IsMainNotificationContact__c set to true.
private static void
testAfterUpdate3()
Verifies that afterUpdate auto-promotes a non-main contact to main when the current main contact's IsMainNotificationContact__c is unchecked.
private static void
testBeforeInsert()
Verifies that beforeInsert rejects an AccountContactRelation insert when the EmailNotifications__c value contains duplicated notification types.
private static void
testBeforeUpdate1()
Verifies that beforeUpdate allows the first relation update but rejects the second when both contacts on the same account are assigned conflicting duplicate notification types.
private static void
testBeforeUpdate2()
Verifies that beforeUpdate rejects a notification update when an existing relation on the same account already has a conflicting duplicate notification type.
